Overview

Vršac is a city in Vojvodina with a population of 36,000. A city in the Banat region of Vojvodina, known for the Vršac Tower, its wine-making tradition, and the nearby Vršac Mountains. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
